# sherpa-panel

A persistent inline panel (a semantic &lt;section> card).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Panel |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-panel/sherpa-panel.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-panel/sherpa-panel.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-panel/sherpa-panel.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-panel/sherpa-panel.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-panel/sherpa-panel.example.json) |

## When to use it

For a panel that sits flush between other surfaces in the page flow, as a `<section>` with a heading, a body and a footer. For a standalone card, use `sherpa-container`; for one that floats over the page, use `sherpa-overlay-panel`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-panel data-heading="Overview"><p>Panel body.</p><sherpa-button slot="footer">Apply</sherpa-button></sherpa-panel>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-collapsed` | boolean |  | boolean; hides the body/footer, leaving the header |
| `data-heading` | text |  | the title of a composed [sherpa-container-header](sherpa-container-header.md); a slotted [slot=header] replaces it |
| `data-status` | text |  | status colour cascade (critical \| warning \| success \| info \| urgent) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | header | header region (reflects has-header): a header of its own, in place of data-heading's |
| (default) | content | the panel body |
| `footer` | footer | footer region (reflects has-footer) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`body`, `footer`, `header`, `heading`, `root`

## populate()

`{ collapsed?, heading? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
